meta.name: Spike Outdoors
meta.description:
The first network for outdoors-men!  Spike Outdoors goes all out with a full slate of shows featuring guys making their living off the land. If it’s high-octane outdoor shows you crave, journey no further than Spike Outdoors!

Shows: Mountain Men, Dangerous Waters, Chasing Monsters, I Shouldn't Be Alive
Available on: Pluto TV
